messages:
sam: Heads-up: Product asked for a tiny "breadcrumb" in the console whenever autoswitchover/fallback runs so PMs can see 'what happened' without opening full audit logs. Thoughts?
lia: Breadcrumbs sound good. we should define exactly what counts as a breadcrumb vs an audit event. breadcrumbs = small row (no prompt), audit = deep payload.
ravi: agree. telemetry/metering: breadcrumbs should be extremely compact (fixed 6 fields) and free-tier friendly. audits stay sampled and costed.
sam: proposal: breadcrumb fields = [timestamp, policy_short, reason_label, model_from, model_to, debug_id]. click expands to "open audit" if available.
elain: typo — "elaine". also UX: show breadcrumb inline on the invocation card, but hide fields behind hover to avoid noise. show a red/yellow/green badge for severity.
lia: severity mapping: red = error-triggered fallback, yellow = latency/throughput-triggered, green = logical fallthrough (e.g., model variant mismatch). keep labels consumer-friendly: "Errored -> fallback" vs "Slow primary -> fallback".
ravi: backend design: two write paths. 1) write breadcrumb row synchronous for every fallback. must be <200 bytes. 2) write full audit async only when sampling bit is set. store full audit in cold bucket with TTL.
sam: retention question: breadcrumbs 30d? audits 90d for enterprise, 14d for self-serve?
eliaine: i vote breadcrumbs 14d too. they still expose some metadata; 30d adds cost. plus product wants quick access not long-term.
lia: we need compliance review for breadcrumbs content. no PII, no prompt text, no user identifiers. only meta IDs and anonymized flags.
ravi: agreed. implementors: ensure we pass a redaction token to the writer and enforce field-level allowlist.
ops-bot: incident-bot: note from runbook #fallbacks: missing explanation in UI caused 3 wakeups in last month. adding human-friendly labels helped previously.
sam: copy suggestion for inline label: "Auto-fallback: Slow primary model" (small link "why?"). clicking why opens short rule: "Triggered when p99 latency > 1s for 30s window."
elaine: add small operator CTA: "Retry" and "Pin primary" in expanded view. those map to existing console actions.
lia: access controls: breadcrumbs visible to org members; "view audit" requires audit-read permission. prevents accidental data exposure.
ravi: perf note: writing breadcrumb synchronously should be idempotent and batched to reduce write amplification. we'll introduce a tiny batching buffer per region with 100ms window.
sam: what about search? PMs want to filter by policy and reason. breadcrumb table should be queryable by policy_short and reason_label and debug_id.
ravi: index on (org, policy_short, reason_label, ts) — cost modest.
elaine: front-end: prefer single-line collapsed with microcopy 'Auto-fallback • Slow primary' and chevron to expand. mobile collapse by default.
sam: edge-case: what if fallback occurs but no breadcrumb write (writer fail)? show badge 'Fallback - audit pending' and surface debug_id if available.
lia: good call. also show 'sampled audit available' vs 'no audit' states.
ops-bot: telemetry-bot: estimated additional storage for breadcrumbs: ~60MB/day at 5M fallbacks. retention 14d -> ~840MB. Approve? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ravi: seems OK. we'll run cost sim for 3 months and re-evaluate.
elaine: final UX copy variants to test in A/B: A) 'Auto-fallback: Slow primary model' B) 'Rerouted to fallback (primary slow)'. we'll see which reduces support pings.
sam: decision alignment: implement breadcrumbs (sync tiny row), audits remain sampled, org-level retention/tiering, UI shows short label + why link + CTA actions, RBAC on audit view.
iaction: ravi -> spec writer endpoint + batching (due Wed); elaine -> mock expand/collapse + mobile (due Tue); lia -> compliance checklist (due Thu); sam -> coordinate A/B flags and update rollout docs.
ops-bot: note logged: decision recorded in #eng-platform 1764300000.
sam: thanks team. closing thread unless more objections. :sparkles:
